what.text: This page follows refugees from Angola living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8043 Angolan refugees in France, 59.9% of all refugees from Angola.
France is the largest host of Angolan refugees, followed by Canada, Germany and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Angola with UNITA from 1990 to 1995 and 1998 to 2002, at war level in most of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Cabinda territory in periods from 1991 to 2025, most recently with FLEC-FAC-TN.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 1505 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
